name: Salaana
source:
Childhood best friends with Naala and Sharu, Salaana is the calmest and gentlest of the three. She often pacifies the more hotblooded two when they get too riled up.

[Based on the [URL=http://ignote.net/operetta2/benibana/benibana2/character.html#TabPanel11]official website profile[/URL].]
